cautions.en: The fetched pricing page also mentioned annual billing figures (e.g. 108 EUR/year for Start) that appear inconsistent with the stated monthly rate; annual figures could not be reliably reconciled in this session and are omitted from plan pricing.
Extra SEPA transfers beyond the included quota cost 0.40 EUR each; international transfers cost 0.45%-1% and card payments abroad 1%-2%.

capabilities.en: French business bank account (IBAN) with free invoicing and quote creation tools.
Payment collection and administrative/charges tracking dashboard for freelancers.
Physical and virtual Mastercards issued per plan, with sub-accounts for budgeting.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 5 SEPA transfers/month before per-transfer fees apply.
Sub-accounts and premium cards are gated behind paid plans (Start and above).

reason.en: Direct competitor French business account with invoicing and card features.
French freelancer administrative and invoicing tool overlapping with Shine's core use case.
French finance platform combining accounting and banking, competing on the same freelance/small business segment.

unknowns: Annual billing amounts shown on the pricing page appeared internally inconsistent with monthly prices; could not be verified precisely in this session.
No platform confirmation source was opened beyond the pricing page; iOS/Android app existence is assumed from general knowledge of the product category, not directly sourced.
